ACCUMULATED_NARRATIVE:  
Alex’s Thursday unfolded as a day marked by persistent friction between her disciplined work ethic and the draining realities of frequent interruptions, low-quality managerial interactions, and interpersonal conflict. Despite fatigue and low affect, she maintained a measured, pragmatic stance—delivering on tasks with diminished zest but without collapse. The day’s texture was one of cautious endurance, punctuated by moments of self-doubt and guardedness, yet underscored by a steady, if muted, resolve to keep moving forward.
